name: CE_PAYMENT_INSTRUMENTS_
description: This table stores the information of all the available payment instruments.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identified first party payment instrument.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT_ALIAS
columns.description: Unique alias of the payment instrument.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NETWORK_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the payment network codes. Values from the lookup type ORA_CE_PAYMENT_NETWORK_TYPE are valid.

columns.name: INSTRUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of payment instrument. Values from the lookup type ORA_CE_PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT_TYPE are valid.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code used for the payment instrument.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the legal entity associated with the payment instrument. This is a foreign key to XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES.

columns.name: ASSET_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the asset account of the payment instrument.

columns.name: CLEARING_CCID
columns.description: Clearing general ledger account identifier for payment instruments.

columns.name: RECONCILIATION_DIFFERENCE_CCID
columns.description: Reconciliation difference general ledger account identifier for payment instrument.

columns.name: BANK_ID
columns.description: Bank identifier that uniquely identifies the bank.

columns.name: BRANCH_ID
columns.description: Bank branch identifier that uniquely identifies the branch.

columns.name: MULTI_CURRENCY_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the multiple currency is allowed.

columns.name: LEDGER_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Functional currency of the ledger.

columns.name: PMT_TO_BANK_EXCHG_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type used to transaction amount from transaction currency to bank account currency.

columns.name: BANK_TO_LEDGER_EXCHG_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type used to transaction amount from bank account currency to ledger currency.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: First date in the date range in which the row is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Last date in the date range in which the row is active.

columns.name: MAX_PAYMENT_LIMIT
columns.description: Default maximum payment amount allowed for payment instrument in a payment batch.

columns.name: MIN_PAYMENT_LIMIT
columns.description: Default minimum payment amount allowed for payment instrument in a payment batch.

columns.name: NETWORK_INSTRUMENT_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The identifier for the payment instrument provided by the payment network.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_NETWORK_ATTRIBUTES
columns.description: Network specific attributes to identify a payment instrument.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: POOLING_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment instrument is enabled for pooling.

columns.name: AP_USE_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment instrument is enabled for payables use.

columns.name: CREDIT_LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Credit limit of a payment instrument.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Indicates the payment term that provides the details about when a payment is due and any discounts that are given for early payment using this payment instrument.

columns.name: UNMATCHED_LINE_SETTLEMNT_BU_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the business unit which is used for settling unmatched statement line dues during card statement processing.
